title: Changed my life
body: Yes this app changed my life. Body doubling makes tasks so much easier for me, and judgment free. I am actually having a lot of things done and it does not feel as a burden. Love it and can’t thank you enough for it.
author: Lylie007

title: Life changing
body: It’s always been so difficult for me to tackle normal, classical stuff, that it even created issues with my partner. Just started using this one to see, without any special expectations, just out of curiosity. Absolutely love it. It really makes me focus on the task I need to do, avoids “side quests” that get me lost, and helps me break it down easily. So long for overwhelming issues and ADHD paralysis! Thank you so much Rich and Rox !
author: Emssé
